description.value:
You touch a computer screen, learning what it has recently displayed, even if it's been rebooted or used for something else since then. You choose one of the following pieces of information, and the computer truthfully displays or plays it.

  • The last command entered into the target.

  • The name of the last file accessed on the target.

  • The name of the last file downloaded to or uploaded from the target.

  • The last 1 minute of audio played from the target.

Heightened (3rd) Choose two of the options.

Heightened (5th) Choose all of the options.

target.value: 1 functional comm unit or computer you can access
